findings.reproduction: On the disposable company, insert the reimbursement link the bridge writer stores for 750000 paise and read posted voucher lines for that reimbursement.
findings.expected: Company books show a payable of 750000 paise and the personal book shows the same receivable, without a second expense.
findings.actual: A cross-domain link row is stored. Posted payable lines are 0. The plan says the two stores are not one database transaction.
findings.rootCause: The bridge writer stores a link and a plan. It does not post the payable voucher.
findings.smallestRepair: Post the payable journal in the same company transaction as the link, and write the personal receivable only after that post succeeds.
findings.regressionTest: Assert posted payable paise equals the reimbursement amount and that salary or expense is not debited a second time.
findings.closureCondition: Disposable books show 750000 paise payable and a matching personal receivable.

findings.reproduction: Post a 2500000 paise payment described as an issued cheque, then call the cheque match effect.
findings.expected: Bank balance stays at the pre-issue figure until the cheque clears.
findings.actual: The posted payment credits the bank immediately. Match reports cashPostedAgain 0, so it does not post a second time. There is no uncleared balance.
findings.rootCause: Cheque match only returns an effect object with cashPosted false. The cash movement already happened at voucher post.
findings.smallestRepair: Hold the bank credit in an uncleared-cheque liability until a separate clear voucher.
findings.regressionTest: Issue 2500000 paise and assert bank net is unchanged; clear it and assert the bank moves once.
findings.closureCondition: Issue and clear are two persisted states and the bank moves only on clear.

findings.reproduction: Buy 2 units at 10000 paise and sell 1 at 15000 paise through the item update, then sum posted STOCK ledger lines.
findings.expected: Remaining stock value of 10000 paise is the STOCK ledger balance.
findings.actual: company_items holds qty 1, value 10000, cogs 10000, revenue 15000. Posted STOCK lines sum to 0.
findings.rootCause: The item update writes company_items and does not post a STOCK voucher.
findings.smallestRepair: Post the buy and the COGS sale to the STOCK control ledger in the same transaction as the item row.
findings.regressionTest: After the same buy and sell, STOCK net paise equals remaining value and COGS equals 10000.
findings.closureCondition: Item subledger and posted STOCK ledger agree to the paise.

findings.reproduction: Call the reset script with only TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at 127.0.0.1 port 1 and database sparowvault_owner_books.
findings.expected: The script exits 2 before opening a connection because the database name has no test substring.
findings.actual: The script attempts the connection and exits 1 with ECONNREFUSED. No tables were dropped because the port was closed.
findings.rootCause: The substring check runs only when TEST_DB_NAME is set. A URL-only invocation skips it.
findings.smallestRepair: Parse the database name from TEST_DATABASE_URL and refuse it unless it contains test.
findings.regressionTest: URL-only name without test exits 2 and does not call createConnection.
findings.closureCondition: Both TEST_DB_NAME and TEST_DATABASE_URL are refused before any socket when the name lacks test.

findings.expected: Every contract table exists in the schema file the test reads, and ALTER ADD statements are idempotent.
findings.actual: 2 tests failed, 581 passed. Company tables are reported missing from that schema, and company voucher index ALTERs do not match the idempotent pattern.
findings.rootCause: Company tables live in company migrations while the phase-02 contract test still compares a schema list that does not include them.
findings.smallestRepair: Point the contract test at the company migration set, and make the index ALTERs information-schema guarded.
findings.regressionTest: The same vitest file exits 0 without changing the expected money totals.
findings.closureCondition: First-run vitest no longer reports those two failures.

findings.reproduction: Read ORDER in apply-migration.php and compare with sql/migrations/20260930_company_phase_sv.sql.
findings.expected: The official order applies every company migration the running PHP requires.
findings.actual: ORDER stops at 20260924_company_perf_indexes.sql. The 20260930 invite-token and bridge_status migration is outside that list.
findings.evidence: command-logs from apply-migration.php --only for the 20260930 files
findings.rootCause: The ordered list was not extended when the 30 Sep SQL was added.
findings.regressionTest: A fresh test database migrated only by apply-migration.php contains bridge_status.
findings.closureCondition: A reset plus the official migrator, with no extra --only, creates the 30 Sep columns.

findings.path: release/hosting-bundle.zip extracted to the evidence directory
findings.reproduction: php -S 127.0.0.1:8097 against the extracted tree with no database credentials in the process environment.
findings.expected: Health returns a configured healthy response, or a guarded refusal that does not boot half the API.
findings.actual: GET /api/healthz.php returned 500 ENV_VALIDATION_FAILED for CLOUD_JWT_SECRET. SPA HTML and JavaScript assets returned 200.
findings.rootCause: The shipped .env.host does not contain a usable JWT secret, and the health check requires one.
findings.smallestRepair: Document the required secret as an operator step and make health distinguish not-configured from crashed.
findings.regressionTest: Serving the extracted zip with an explicit test env returns healthy, and serving it with empty env does not touch a non-test database.
findings.closureCondition: Extracted package health is green only when a disposable test database and a non-production secret are supplied.

findings.actual: Exit 1. Three errors: definition for rule react-hooks/exhaustive-deps was not found.
findings.rootCause: The rule is referenced and the plugin that defines it is not loaded.
findings.smallestRepair: Load the hooks plugin or remove the unused rule reference. Do not disable the rule to hide a hook bug.
findings.closureCondition: The three files lint without a missing-rule error.
